svg.title: Call GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol through the Vectoree Gateway
svg.desc: Cover. GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol on one Vectoree endpoint. OpenAI standard rates: Astra $8 input and $40 output, Sol $2 input and $10 output, per million tokens.
